report.requirement: The controller's identity and how to contact it about personal data
report.evidence: All comments, queries and requests relating to our use of your information are welcomed and should be addressed to Talabat Middle East FZ-L.L.C
report.reason: The policy provides the identity of the controller and contact information.

report.requirement: Contact details of the data protection officer (DPO)
report.condition: The controller has appointed a DPO
report.reason: The policy does not mention a Data Protection Officer.

report.requirement: The personal data that is collected
report.evidence: Talabat may collect the following information from users of our site: first name, last name, street address, area and city, phone and contact numbers, e-mail address, GPS location (mobile site), ID
report.reason: The policy clearly states the types of personal data collected.

report.requirement: The means used to collect personal data
report.evidence: Talabat also uses web analytics software to track and analyze traffic on the site in connection with Talabat advertising and promotion of Talabat services
report.reason: The policy mentions some means of collection but lacks detail.

report.requirement: The purpose of collecting and processing personal data
report.evidence: Talabat uses PII to create users' Talabat accounts, to communicate with users about Talabat services, to offer users additional services, promotions and special offers
report.reason: The policy clearly states the purposes for collecting and processing personal data.

report.requirement: The legal basis for collecting personal data (e.g. consent, contract, legal obligation)
report.evidence: Talabat may also disclose PII to third parties such as attorneys, collection agencies, tribunals or law enforcement authorities pursuant to valid requests
report.reason: The policy mentions disclosure to third parties but does not specify the legal basis for collecting personal data.

report.requirement: Which personal data is mandatory and which is optional
report.evidence: Personal information required during the order process includes name, address, phone number, email address and other similar information used to identify you and complete an order.
report.reason: The policy clearly states which personal data is mandatory for order placement.

report.requirement: The consequences of not providing personal data
report.evidence: you will not be able to register on the website and place orders.
report.reason: The policy mentions consequences of not providing certain data but does not detail all potential consequences.

report.requirement: The parties personal data is disclosed or shared with, and their capacity
report.evidence: Talabat shares collected PII to third-party vendors and service providers with whom Talabat works to provide application programming interfaces
report.reason: The policy clearly states the parties with whom personal data is shared.

report.requirement: Whether personal data is transferred, disclosed or processed outside the Kingdom
report.reason: The policy does not mention anything about data transfer outside the Kingdom.

report.requirement: How long personal data is kept, or the criteria used to decide
report.reason: The policy does not specify how long personal data is kept or the criteria used to decide.

report.requirement: How personal data is stored and destroyed
report.evidence: we may be required to retain some of your information if we process it as part of our legal obligations
report.reason: The policy mentions retention but does not clearly explain how personal data is stored and destroyed.

report.requirement: The data subject's rights: to be informed, access, obtain a copy, correct, and request destruction
report.evidence: you may later access it, update it, modify it and delete any inaccuracies by accessing your account
report.reason: The policy mentions some rights of the data subject but does not cover all specified rights.

report.requirement: How the data subject can exercise their rights
report.reason: The policy does not explain how the data subject can exercise their rights.
The policy does not provide information on how to withdraw consent.

report.requirement: The measures taken to protect personal data
report.condition: Large-scale or continuous processing, monitoring, new technologies, or automated decisions
report.evidence: We use various technical and management practices to help protect the confidentiality, security and integrity of data stored on our system
report.reason: The policy clearly states the measures taken to protect personal data.

report.requirement: Whether decisions are made solely by automated processing
report.condition: Large-scale or continuous processing, monitoring, new technologies, or automated decisions
report.reason: The policy does not mention anything about decisions made solely by automated processing.
